title: Connecting to the Game Server
summary: From opening the connection to session verification.
description:
# Connecting to the Game Server

## Preconditions

The client has selected a server and received game session parameters.

## Sequence

1. Establish a TCP connection.
2. Send {{link packet:protocol-version}}.
3. Process {{link packet:key-packet}}.
4. Submit game session information.
5. Await verification and the character list.

## Branches

- Unsupported revision.
- Invalid session.
- Connection closed before completion.

Message boundaries: {{link article:game-framing}}.
